questions.prompt: What is the difference between s.max() and s.idxmax()?
choices: max gives the value, idxmax gives its label

questions.prompt: Adding two Series with partly different indexes gives what for a label in only one?
questions.explain: Alignment is by label. A label with no partner has nothing to add, so the result is missing rather than wrong.
